notes.title: 20 Small Mazes is Steam Deck verified! + SJ update + DLC???
notes.content:
"20 Small Mazes" is officially Steam Deck verified!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44703486/eaa68c2121bd3547de242adffa9dfd7440dc695b.png[/img]

Wooho!!!




"Strange Jigsaws", my next game, is coming along well and I'm hoping to release it this summer. Here's a new screenshot, from somewhere deep in the Jigsawverse... 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44703486/572e052adaa94f4df4d999e8ccde96f2dcb63578.png[/img]

You can wishlist and follow the game here: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2702170/Strange_Jigsaws/]Strange Jigsaws Wishlist Link[/url]




Also, I have fully designed a DLC for "20 Small Mazes". I am working on implementing it now, and I am planning to release it [b]later this year.[/b]

I hope you will enjoy the "20 More, Somehow Even Smaller, Mazes" DLC. I'll get a store page up when it's a little bit further along.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44703486/85790194f4e14e4f73eaa24fd6f04ef3b9430706.png[/img]

Hope you all are healthy and doing well,

FLEB

notes.title: Small Update #3
notes.content:
I'm continuing to work to improve the game. 

Some larger fixes:

-Added controller glyphs for most puzzles, and some controller support. This is an ongoing project. Some puzzles are still difficult to do with controller (Five-Year-Old, Draft) and one you still can't do (Enter Password). I'm hoping to add full controller support soon.

-Made performance improvements. This is an ongoing project. I am working at rewriting the main puzzle selection code, which is really not performant. I also was able to reduce the size of the game download by 50%.


Some smaller changes:

-Changed menu text to show the game saves automatically
-Changed new game maze to clarify that each slot is a new game
-Added a clarification to not click on my kid's maze to start moving the dot
-Added version number
-Changed font size on the resolution dropdown
-Ensured default resolution on Steam Deck is correct
-Fixed a bug where the background sound wouldn't play for puzzles

Thank you all for playing! I'm hoping to announce my next game in about two weeks.

notes.title: Small Update #2 (And 200,000+ downloads!)
notes.content:
Two small updates:
-Added a 4K resolution option
-Ensured the options button was always on top, so it couldn't be covered up and lost under the mazes

ALSO

"20 Small Mazes" passed 230,000 downloads recently! That is a crazy number!

I am extremely grateful, and the response to "20 Small Mazes" will be a memory I will always cherish. I've really enjoyed reading your reviews, how much you liked my daughter's artwork, and how much you truly hated the sliding puzzle. My next game won't have a sliding puzzle, maybe.

Thank you all for playing!

FLEB

notes.title: Small Update #1
notes.content:
Made a few changes:

1. Added a brightness slider in the options.

2. Gravity has been having some intermittent issues. I made a few adjustments, and also added a reset. Now if you press "r" the puzzle should reset.

3. For the Password puzzle, you no longer need to press "enter" to enter the password.

-FLEB
